title: Turn query and key pairs with RoPE
description: A quick reference for RoPE's coordinate pairs, frequencies, absolute rotations, relative score geometry, and masking boundary.

terms.definition: A pairwise rotation of query and key features that adds relative-position geometry to attention scores.
Two neighboring feature coordinates rotated together using one shared pair frequency.
A two-dimensional orthogonal transformation turning one feature pair by a chosen angle.
The radians advanced per absolute position for one indexed feature pair.
The positive value used in the exponent schedule that determines every pair frequency.
The token index supplied to RoPE when determining each pair's local angle.
The key position minus the query position, preserving direction rather than only distance.
For unchanged query and key contents, shifting both positions equally preserves their dot product.
A rotation preserving each pair's Euclidean norm and the tensor shape.
RoPE rotates queries and keys while leaving value vectors unrotated in this lesson.
The separate visibility rule blocking future key positions independently of RoPE geometry.
